facts.value: 1724, election of Cyril VI as Catholic patriarch of Antioch

citations.excerpt: However, in 1724 Seraphim Tanas, who had studied at the Roman Propaganda , was elected Patriarch of Antioch by the latinizing party. He at once made his submission to Rome and sent a Catholic profession of faith .
From that time there have been two kinds of Melchites in these countries, the Catholic Melchites who kept the communion of Rome , and schismatical (Orthodox) Melchites who followed Constantinople

facts.value: Follows the Byzantine (Orthodox) liturgy, ceremonial and calendar while acknowledging the authority of Rome.

citations.excerpt: They follow the Orthodox Eastern liturgy, ceremonial and calendar, but acknowledge the papal and doctrinal authority of Rome.

facts.value: Catholics of Syria, Palestine and Egypt who follow the Byzantine liturgy. The name Melkite first meant those who remained faithful to Chalcedon.

citations.excerpt: Melchites are the people of Syria , Palestine, and Egypt who remained faithful to the Council of Chalcedon (451) when the greater part turned Monophysite .

facts.value_before_verify: Byzantine-rite Catholics of Syria, Palestine and Egypt. The name Melkite first meant those who accepted Chalcedon.
